title: Google Ads Transparency input
description: Minimal input: {"domains":["shopify.com"],"maxResults":3}. $3 per 1000 delivered ads. includeAdText defaults true and includes approximate English OCR at no extra charge. Provide domains or advertiserIds.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Bare domains, e.g. ["shopify.com"]. At least one domain or advertiser ID is required; 20 sources total. Domain results can include resellers or other advertisers mentioning the domain. Ownership is NOT inferred. Use advertiserIds for an exact legal advertiser. No customer login needed.

advertiserIds.title: AdvertiserIds
advertiserIds.description: Exact advertiser accounts, e.g. ["AR01625195283841286145"], from ad_url or advertiser_id in earlier results. Empty = use domains. Provide IDs instead of domains when you need only a specific legal advertiser; do not combine both for that request.

maxAdsPerSource.title: MaxAdsPerSource
maxAdsPerSource.description: Hard cap per domain or advertiser, even when maxResults is higher: default 20; range 1-1000. For 50 ads from one source, set this AND maxResults to 50. Counts delivered matches AFTER date/format filters, exclusions and monitoring. maxPagesPerSource bounds the scan; fewer matches are possible. 20 delivered ads cost $0.06.

maxResults.title: MaxResults
maxResults.description: For N ads from one source, set BOTH maxResults and maxAdsPerSource to N; the per-source default 20 still applies. Total paid ad cap across sources after deduplication/filters; default 100. Maximum charge = maxResults × $0.003. Set Apify run option maxTotalChargeUsd for a dollar ceiling (not input JSON). One free status row per visited source; skipped sources have none. Status rows do not count toward caps.

includeAdText.title: IncludeAdText
includeAdText.description: true (DEFAULT) attempts English OCR or renderer text from up to 3 creative previews per ad; included in $0.003/ad. OCR is approximate, not a verified transcript. false = previews and metadata only, same price and faster. Check ad_text, text_method and text_status; missing text is null.

region.title: Region
region.description: "ALL" default means all regions. Country where ads were shown, not advertiser headquarters. Use "US", "GB", "DE", etc.; choose ALL if no region was requested. Source-side filter. Reported first_shown/last_shown are source search dates, not a spend or performance measure.

adFormat.title: AdFormat
adFormat.description: "all" default. "text", "image" or "video" filters Google’s format classification before caps/billing. A text ad may have only an image preview and require OCR. Does not filter by Search/YouTube platform; platform targeting is not a supported input.

lastShownAfter.title: LastShownAfter
lastShownAfter.description: Empty = no lower bound. "2026-10-01" includes ads last shown on or after that UTC date, filtering returned search metadata before billing. This is NOT first-launch date or proof an ad is still running. Scan limits can leave additional matching ads unvisited.

lastShownBefore.title: LastShownBefore
lastShownBefore.description: Empty = no upper bound. "2026-10-16" includes ads last shown on or before that UTC date. Inclusive and must be on/after lastShownAfter. No charge for filtered records. This is a source last-shown date, not a complete historical archive.

onlyNewOrChanged.title: OnlyNewOrChanged
onlyNewOrChanged.description: false default. true requires monitorKey: first run delivers baseline ads; later runs deliver unseen or changed creative-preview records. Unchanged rows are free. Serving-date changes alone do not count. Never reports stopped ads. Set an Apify schedule separately and avoid overlapping runs for the same key.

monitorKey.title: MonitorKey
monitorKey.description: Empty by default. With onlyNewOrChanged=true, use a stable key such as "shopify-weekly" (letters/digits/_/-; max 60). Stores up to 50000 paid creative fingerprints in your named storage. Same key requires identical sources/filters. Use a new key for a fresh baseline; do not run the same key concurrently.

excludeCreativeIds.title: ExcludeCreativeIds
excludeCreativeIds.description: [] default. Skip creative_id values or advertiser_id:creative_id pairs from past output before billing, e.g. ["CR02097857130550788097"]. Maximum 10000. Useful for externally managed state. Distinct advertiser/creative pairs are deduplicated across the entire run.

maxPagesPerSource.title: MaxPagesPerSource
maxPagesPerSource.description: 5 by default; 1-20 search pages, up to 100 source records per page. Scanning stops at this bound even if filters/monitoring deliver fewer ads than requested. No separate page fee. Raise for deeper scans; partial coverage is explicit in free status rows. This does not promise exhaustive historical coverage.
